subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Reptiles: crocodile, snake, lizard, tortoise; scaly body and lays eggs

show.line: Snakes, lizards, crocodiles and tortoises are reptiles. Reptiles have scaly skin and lay eggs.

rounds.prompt: How does a reptile's skin look?
Which reptile carries a shell on its back?
Most baby reptiles come out of what?

hints: Reptiles have scales, not fur or feathers.
Snakes, lizards, crocodiles and tortoises are reptiles.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a reptile.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: A rabbit! It is a reptile.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! A rabbit has fur. It is not a reptile.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Reptiles have scales. A lizard is a reptile!

parent_line: Can name reptiles and say they have scales and lay eggs.
